interpretation: All means the relevant end-user settings for Kestrel's standalone local browser and local agent. Vendor-account, shopping, wallet, family, enterprise-policy, OS-only, and internal-flag surfaces are recorded as not_applicable rather than simulated.

statusDefinitions.implemented: A real Kestrel setting or native action exists and is covered by repository evidence.
statusDefinitions.not_applicable: The reference item is explicitly excluded from Kestrel's standalone local product and has a reason category.

Kestrel clears history or native cookies/cache through typed native actions.
Permission decisions are stored per HTTP(S) origin and can be revoked.
Kestrel keeps password data in its protected native vault and only offers exact-origin HTTPS autofill.
Kestrel offers protected payment-card autofill only after explicit confirmation.

Kestrel supports a timeout, exclusions, and an explicit sleep-now action.

Default page zoom is persisted and applied to native views.
Default font family and minimum text size are native creation preferences.
Kestrel's search engine and local suggestions are explicit and independently configurable.
Suggestions never leave the local profile.
Typed native clear-cache/cookie/history actions back this control.
Kestrel remembers and revokes per-origin decisions with an explicit native permission boundary.
Passwords remain in Kestrel's protected vault.
Payment cards remain protected and require confirmation.
Kestrel exposes real sleeping-tab controls and an allowlist for excluded domains.
The native download service owns folder selection and save dialogs.
The native session receives the selected spellcheck language.
Verified extension management is kept separate from agent plugins.
Registration/status uses typed native IPC.

Only browser preferences reset; user content and credentials stay put.
Kestrel's import/export is intentionally limited to safe, reviewable JSON.
